statusText: WATCH: Tail remains below the blocking threshold while cross-asset Stress is extreme and a persistent current NQ path is not independently verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Fresh evidence shows weak Asian equities, higher oil and yields, but flat S&P 500 e-mini futures and no verified persistent NQ extension.
headline: Asian risk pressure rises, but U.S. futures stay mixed and Tail remains in WATCH
body: Reuters reported sharp early losses in Asian equities while S&P 500 e-mini futures were flat, Brent rose to $95.34 and the U.S. 10-year yield reached 4.798%. Fresh shared Finviz context showed delayed NQ and ES slightly positive. Without independently verified persistent NQ extension, Tail remains below the blocking threshold.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours shifted from overnight WATCH/low conditions into a U.S.-session trend-down regime. Tail peaked at 47% at 19:00 UTC, then fell back to WATCH as late-session and reopen price action broke persistent one-way structure.
outlookSummary: Tail remains below the block threshold overnight if U.S. futures stay two-sided. Conditional risk concentrates around ADP at 12:15 UTC, the 13:30 cash open, Factory Orders at 14:00, EIA at 14:30, the Beige Book at 18:00 and Broadcom's call at 21:00.
